claims.text: A machine-learning interatomic potential can determine melting temperatures of high-entropy alloys accurately.
A machine-learning interatomic potential can determine enthalpies of fusion of high-entropy alloys accurately.
A machine-learning interatomic potential can determine entropies of fusion of high-entropy alloys accurately.
A machine-learning interatomic potential can determine volume changes at melting for high-entropy alloys accurately.
A machine-learning interatomic potential can determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties of high-entropy alloys accurately.
The proposed machine-learning interatomic potential can determine these properties efficiently.
The interatomic potential can be developed using training information from ab initio molecular dynamics or density functional theory.
The proposed approach is applicable across different high-entropy-alloy compositions and phases.
The approach is intended to apply particularly to alloys containing three to six principal elements.
The predicted melting and liquid thermodynamic properties will have mean absolute errors below 5% relative to experimental values.
Transferability to different high-entropy-alloy compositions and phases may limit the potential's accuracy.
The hypothesis is falsified if errors exceed 10% for more than 20% of tested high-entropy alloys.
